causalComparison.baselineSame026Apk: 21:04:29 autostart off: USER REQUESTED / FORCE STOP, stopped=true, enabled services null; 21:06:52 and 21:08:30 after visible autostart enable: OTHER KILLS BY SYSTEM / SwipeUpClean, stopped=false, service rebound and blocking returned without opening FocusNest
causalComparison.interpretation: On this phone, enabling autostart avoids the observed package force-stop path during a single-card swipe. The process can still die and the system rebinds accessibility. This does not bypass a genuine force stop or establish zero interruption.

earlierCandidateAndToolingFindings: First new build used a different local debug signing home; Android rejected its in-place update. Data was preserved; original E-drive signing home was then verified and reused

A shell launch returned START_TASK_TO_FRONT with the existing settings child activity, causing an automation focus timeout. Logs identified the task stack; subsequent launch uses CLEAR_TOP to resume the intended MainActivity
limitations: Required conditions were tested only on this Xiaomi 15 firmware; other brands, other HyperOS versions, long-term idle and battery consumption are unverified
Process death and rebind can introduce a recovery gap; reported reminder delays include ADB launch and inspection overhead, not guaranteed zero delay
Autostart disabled is an expected negative control and still fails; genuine system Force stop, revoked accessibility, uninstall and safe mode remain independent boundaries
Device reboot and clearing all recent tasks were not tested in this round; unrelated user tasks were preserved
The natural-expiry session began on the baseline and was restored through upgrades; a new final-build session separately covered start and two-step cancellation
Platform-signature negative cases were reviewed as fail-closed code paths; no system package was replaced on the user phone for testing
First-install permission, batch picker and rule edge cases use the 28 host tests and prior records; no destructive first-install phone reset was performed
